IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair walks a runway in a white knit long-sleeve polo
with black placket trim and a small embroidered
emblem, paired with matching white knit shorts with
black piping and a side tie sash. Her expression is
calm and direct. Deep maroon wall and dark navy
runway with soft light. Palette of white, black, and
deep plum. Crisp and graphic, in the style of a
spring runway show.
